newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Unocal seeks $450 mln Bangladesh power deal.
newsitem.headline: Unocal seeks $450 mln Bangladesh power deal.

text.p: U.S. firm Unocal and Bangladesh's Power Development Board (PDB) have begun negotiations on a proposed $450 million integrated power project in the country's western region, PDB officials said on Thursday.
"A deal (on the proposed project) may be reached soon if the week-long negotiations are fruitful," said one official.

He said the Ministry of Energy had earlier agreed in principle to the Unocal proposal, which included construction of a gas pipeline, power plants and transmission lines in the energy-starved western region.
The proposed pipeline will connect the Shahbazpur gas field in the coastal Bhola district to the southwestern districts of Barisal and Khulna.
The project will be implemented in two phases over 39 months from the date of agreement.
Unocal was earlier given a letter of intent to develop a part of the Shahbazpur gas field where state-owned oil and gas agency Petrobangla made a major find in 1995.
Royal Dutch/Shell Group also proposed to implement a $2.5 billion integrated power and petroleum project based on the gas of Shahbazpur field, PDB officials said without giving details.
